bio: The stylish Covent Garden Hotel is situated within the dazzling theatre district, and only a short walk from the Royal Opera House, Soho and the capital's vibrant shopping district.  Afternoon Tea at The Covent Garden Hotel is always a decadent affair. Begin with a selection of dainty finger sandwiches, followed by freshly-baked scones and an array of tempting sweet treats, including an apricot battenberg cake and a violet and white chocolate macaron. All of this is served alongside your choice of speciality tea.  Covent Garden Hotel offer a Gentlemen's or Covent Garden Afternoon Tea which is served in the chic Brasserie Max Restaurant , the perfect place to enjoy Afternoon Tea with friends, family or business colleagues.  Please note that each guest dining must order Afternoon Tea. One Afternoon Tea cannot be shared between two or more guests.
